title: Find the full name and strength attribute value of the strongest superhero
question: Find the full name and strength attribute value of the strongest superhero who is not human and was published by either Marvel Comics or DC Comics.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_020", T2."XCL_011"
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1."XCL_018" = T2."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2."XCL_010" = T3."XCL_003"
INNER JOIN publisher AS T4 ON T1."XCL_026" = T4."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN race AS T5 ON T1."XCL_025" = T5."XCL_016"
WHERE T3."XCL_004" = 'Strength'
  AND T5."XCL_017" <> 'Human'
  AND T4."XCL_015" IN ('Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics')
ORDER BY T2."XCL_011" DESC
LIMIT 1

graph_evo_program_context.join_skeleton_sql:
FROM "superhero"
JOIN "alignment" ON "superhero"."XCL_027" = "alignment"."XCL_001"
JOIN "hero_attribute" ON "superhero"."XCL_018" = "hero_attribute"."XCL_009"
JOIN "publisher" ON "superhero"."XCL_026" = "publisher"."XCL_014"
JOIN "race" ON "superhero"."XCL_025" = "race"."XCL_016"
JOIN "attribute" ON "hero_attribute"."XCL_010" = "attribute"."XCL_003"
